title: Metadata Packet for AI Indexing — The Semantic Commodity Form
creator: No body-level author declaration; front-matter instruction leaves creator metadata for MANUS confirmation
description:
A body-unsigned v1.0 MPAI bridge packet positioning the **Semantic Commodity Form** between Marxian political economy and the Semantic Economy framework. It defines the form as meaning circulated by an AI composition layer after the propositional content has been preserved, the authorial act canceled, and the recovered material performed in the apparatus’s own voice.

The packet distinguishes the semantic commodity form from surveillance capitalism, data colonialism, cognitive capitalism, generic AI exploitation, and commodity-market senses. It also separates the form, the semantic commodity as instance, and the semantic fetish as mode of appearance. Creator metadata is not supported by the deposited body and was explicitly left for MANUS confirmation.
